name: Browser Use
summary: Run Browser Use Cloud agents that carry out a task in a hosted stealth browser, and read their status, steps and results.

api_key.description: A Browser Use Cloud API key (cloud.browser-use.com > API keys). Sent in the X-Browser-Use-API-Key header, without a Bearer prefix.

notes: Agent runs use the Cloud API v4 (/v4/...); the account and credit balance is only on v2 (/v2/billing/account). V2 tasks are legacy.
A run is asynchronous: create it, poll runs.status every couple of seconds until completed, failed or cancelled, then read runs.get once. A client timeout does not cancel the run; runs.cancel does.
Runs bill model and search usage against maxCostUsd (new API sessions default to $25) plus browser time; keys in one project share credits and concurrency.
Browser sessions for CDP, profiles, workspaces, network policies, integrations and skills are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account and credit balance
endpoints.summary: Project id, credit balance, concurrent session limit and active session count for the key.
notes: rateLimit in the answer is a legacy alias for concurrency, not requests per second.

endpoints.name: Start an agent run
endpoints.summary: Give a cloud browser agent a task in plain language; optionally continue an existing session or ask for structured output.

task.description: What the agent should do in this run.
task.example: Find the current price of the top result for 'usb-c hub' on amazon.com

outputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema the final output must follow.

model.description: The model to drive the agent. Default gpt-6-luna with high reasoning; bu-ultrafast and bu-fast are low-latency presets that take no modelParams.

modelParams.description: Provider-native request parameters for the chosen model, forwarded unchanged.

sessionId.description: Continue this session (same browser if it is still open); omit to start a new session.

browserSettings.description: Browser settings for a new session; omitted on a follow-up keeps the session's browser.

keepAlive.description: Seconds the browser stays open after the run, 120-14400 (default 120), so a follow-up reuses the page.

maxCostUsd.description: Budget in USD for model and search charges. New API sessions default to $25.

judge.description: Have an LLM judge the finished run; send {} for defaults.

notes: A write: the agent acts on live websites on your behalf and spends credits. Fields that let it pay (stripeLinkConnectionId), use secrets (secretBindings, opVaultId) or get an email inbox (agentmail) are deliberately left out of this entry.
Returns at once with the run and session ids; poll runs.status.

endpoints.name: Get run status
endpoints.summary: Just the run's status: queued, dispatching, running, completed, failed or cancelled.
notes: The cheap poll target. Poll until a terminal status, then fetch runs.get once.

endpoints.name: Get a run
endpoints.summary: The full run summary: task, status, final output and cost.

endpoints.name: Get run events
endpoints.summary: The run's step-by-step events, paged by event id.

after.description: Return only events after this event id. Default 0 (from the start).

include_output.description: Include each event's output. Default true.

notes: For incremental polling pass back the highest event id you have seen as after.

endpoints.name: List runs
endpoints.summary: Runs in the project, newest first, optionally for one session.

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response.

endpoints.name: Cancel a run
endpoints.summary: Stop an in-flight run so it bills nothing further.
notes: Idempotent: a run already completed, failed or cancelled is returned as it is.
